title: Global Markets Brief — 24 Nov 2026
intro: Global markets are displaying a sharp risk-on recovery during the European session, led by aggressive tech buying in US index futures. Investor sentiment is stabilizing despite lingering geopolitical friction in the Middle East and ongoing supply chain trade restrictions.

sections.heading: 🌍 Macro tone
sections.content: The session is characterized by a broad risk-on rotation into equities while safe-haven volatility gauges compress sharply. The primary catalyst is heavy momentum in mega-cap technology names, spearheaded by Nvidia-related developments.

sections.heading: 🛢 Oil desk
sections.content: Crude benchmarks diverged with WTI trading slightly lower at 80.05 and Brent dropping more sharply to 86.55 amid developments regarding tanker security in the Strait of Hormuz. The Brent-WTI spread contracted to 6.50 on the day.

sections.heading: Cross-asset read
sections.content: US 10-year yields held steady near 4.918% alongside a flat DXY at 104.31, while equities rallied strongly led by a 6.86% surge in the Nasdaq 100. Meanwhile, commodities experienced broad pressure with metals like Gold down 0.86% to 3,620.00.

sections.heading: Potential scenarios
sections.content:
- *▲ Bullish · Nasdaq 100 — above 26,800 opens 28,000 · invalid below 26,500*
Massive tech-sector momentum following explosive upward revisions in AI-related equities.
- *▼ Bearish · Brent — below 86.00 opens 83.00 · invalid above 88.00*
Downward pressure on crude prices driven by easing near-term supply disruption fears.
- *▼ Bearish · Gold — below 3,610.00 opens 3,480.00 · invalid above 3,650.00*
Safe-haven outflow as equity markets aggressively absorb risk.
- *▲ Bullish · Natural Gas — above 3.650 opens 3.900 · invalid below 3.500*
Strong double-digit gains reflecting robust immediate demand pressures.

sections.heading: Key risks
sections.content:
- Escalation of tanker incidents and military escort complications in the Strait of Hormuz.
- Potential volatility surrounding upcoming US consumer confidence data releases.
